title: Mississippi Contractor License Status
description: Check public contractor license records from the Mississippi State Board of Contractors. Provide either one license_number or name, or a non-empty queries batch (maximum 100). Each lookup costs $0.02 after Store publication; source outages are not charged. The board cautions its public results may change after publication; verify directly before relying on a record.

license_number.title: License number
license_number.description: Mississippi contractor license number (digits only). Use this or Business name for one lookup.

name.title: Business name
name.description: Search for a business-name substring in Mississippi State Board of Contractors records.

max_results.title: Maximum name matches
max_results.description: Maximum records returned for a business-name search; capped at 10.

queries.title: Batch lookups
queries.description: Optional batch of up to 100 objects, each with license_number or name (and optional max_results). Each source request is rate-limited and billed as one lookup.
